name: Bastian Ledd
source_profile:
Bastian Ledd (NE) — Shipping Broker and Warehouse Proprietor

Bastian is a prosperous merchant who owns several warehouses and maintains extensive interests in Westbridge's freight trade. A sharp and calculating businessman, he has accumulated considerable wealth by purchasing distressed cargo, extending credit to struggling merchants, and negotiating favorable shipping contracts.

Bastian maintains cordial relationships with Celia Dunlow and other officials responsible for the town's commercial administration. He considers the expansion of customs regulations and improved infrastructure advantageous to established businesses, particularly those with sufficient resources to navigate the increasingly complicated licensing requirements.

His commercial ambitions have brought him into conflict with Hadria Senn and other independent boatmen, whose resistance to exclusive shipping arrangements he regards as sentimental and impractical. Bastian believes that larger commercial enterprises are better equipped to manage the risks of river transportation and that smaller operators should accept employment or contracts with established firms rather than attempt to compete independently.

Although Bastian conducts most of his business legitimately, he is not above exploiting distressed merchants or purchasing cargo whose ownership is disputed. His aggressive methods have attracted the attention of Sheriff Bram Eddows, who suspects that several profitable transactions have involved questionable commercial practices.
